name: Shogo Sakai
description: {{nihongo|'''Shogo Sakai'''|酒井 省吾|Sakai Shōgo|born September 23, 1960}} is a Japanese composer who primarily works on video games. He is best known for composing for ''[[Mother 3]]'', as well as various ''[[Kirby (series)|Kirby]]'' and ''[[Super Smash Bros.]]'' games. Currently a freelance composer, he was employed at [[Data East]] from 1987 to 1996 and [[HAL Laboratory]] from 1996 to 2023.
